trigger.alarmAssignmentSettingsHint: Choose which assignment changes send notifications. Leave filters empty to match all types, severities, and statuses.
trigger.alarmAssignmentNotifyOnRequired: Select at least one assignment event
trigger.alarmSettingsHint: Choose which alarm events send notifications. Leave type and severity empty to match all alarms.
trigger.alarmTypesHint: Type an alarm type and press Enter to add it. You can add multiple types.
trigger.alarmNotifyOnRequired: Select at least one alarm event
trigger.alarmStopEscalation: Stop escalation when the alarm reaches these statuses
trigger.alarmStopEscalationHint: Applies when the recipient escalation chain has more than one level. Leave empty to match any status.
trigger.deviceActivityDescription: Choose which devices to monitor and which activity changes send notifications.
trigger.deviceActivityDevicesHint: Leave empty to apply this rule to all devices.
trigger.deviceActivityProfilesHint: Leave empty to apply this rule to all device profiles.
trigger.deviceActivityNotifyOnRequired: Select at least one notification event
trigger.entityActionHint: Choose entity types and the actions that send notifications.
trigger.entityTypesRequired: Select at least one entity type
trigger.entityCreatedHint: Notify when an entity of a selected type is created.
trigger.entityUpdatedHint: Notify when an entity of a selected type is updated.
trigger.entityDeletedHint: Notify when an entity of a selected type is deleted.
trigger.alarmCommentHint: Filter alarms and choose which comments send notifications. Leave filters empty to match all alarms.
trigger.onlyUserCommentsHint: Notify on comments added by users and ignore system comments.
trigger.notifyOnCommentUpdateHint: Also send notifications when existing comments are updated.
trigger.apiUsageSettingsHint: Send notifications when selected API features change usage state.
trigger.apiUsageFeaturesHint: Leave empty to monitor all API features.
trigger.apiUsageNotifyOnRequired: Select at least one API usage state
trigger.edgeConnectionHint: Send notifications when an edge instance connects or disconnects.
trigger.edgeConnectionEdgesHint: Leave empty to apply this rule to all edge instances.
trigger.edgeConnectionNotifyOnHint: Leave empty to notify on both connection and disconnection events.
trigger.entitiesLimitHint: Send notifications when entity counts reach a percentage of their configured limits.
trigger.entitiesLimitTypesHint: Leave empty to monitor all supported entity types.
trigger.entitiesLimitThresholdHint: Choose 0% to 100%. The default sends notifications at 80% usage.
trigger.newPlatformVersionHint: Notify recipients using the selected template when a new platform version becomes available. No additional settings are required.
trigger.rateLimitsSettingsHint: Send notifications when selected APIs reach their rate limits.
trigger.rateLimitsApisHint: Leave empty to match all APIs. You can also enter a custom API name and press Enter to add it.
trigger.limitedApiCASSANDRA_WRITE_QUERIES_RULE_E: Cassandra write queries for Rule Engine
trigger.limitedApiCASSANDRA_READ_QUERIES_RULE_EN: Cassandra read queries for Rule Engine
trigger.resourcesShortageHint: Set notification thresholds for CPU, memory and storage usage. Each defaults to 80%.
trigger.cpuThresholdHint: Notify when CPU usage reaches this percentage.
trigger.ramThresholdHint: Notify when memory usage reaches this percentage.
trigger.storageThresholdHint: Notify when storage usage reaches this percentage.
trigger.lifecycleHint: Monitor start, update, and stop events for rule chains and their nodes.
trigger.lifecycleRuleChainsHint: Leave empty to apply this rule to all rule chains.
trigger.lifecycleEventsHint: Leave empty to monitor all lifecycle events.
trigger.lifecycleOnlyRuleChainFailures: Only notify on rule chain lifecycle failures
trigger.lifecycleOnlyRuleNodeFailures: Only notify on rule node lifecycle failures
trigger.lifecycleOnlyFailuresHint: When enabled, send notifications only when the selected lifecycle operations fail.
trigger.lifecycleTrackRuleNodeEventsHint: Also monitor lifecycle events for nodes in the selected rule chains.
trigger.edgeCommunicationFailureHint: Send notifications when communication with the selected edge instances fails.
trigger.taskProcessingFailureHint: Send notifications when task processing fails. This trigger requires no additional settings.
